note: Indometh, IV bolus (dose 25 mg is a test constant); a one-compartment model on a biexponential profile, a poor but legitimate fit
weights_note: iteratively reweighted fixed point (specs/fit.md FIT-WGT-03): the weights of the solution, constants in the derivatives

method.estimates: minpack.lm::nlsLM (Levenberg-Marquardt, ftol = ptol = 1e-15); stats::nls (Gauss-Newton, relative-offset tol 1e-7) is required to agree within 1e-5 relative where it converges from the same start
method.statistics: oracle/scripts/fit_wls.R, formulas of specs/fit.md FIT-OUT-01 to FIT-OUT-07 on the analytic Jacobian; standard errors and S checked against summary.nls

definitions.aic: N * ln(WRSS) + 2 * P (FIT-OUT-07, an assumed form)
definitions.ss_corrected: sum of w * (y - weighted mean of y)^2
definitions.corr_obs_pred: weighted Pearson correlation of observed and predicted values, weights w
definitions.ci: estimate +/- t(0.975; DF) * SE; planar: estimate +/- sqrt(P * F(0.95; P, DF)) * SE
definitions.eigenvalue: eigenvalues of the correlation matrix of the estimates, decreasing; condition_number = largest / smallest; kappa_jacobian = sqrt of the same ratio for the Jacobian with unit-length columns
definitions.secondary: cl = v * k, half_life = ln 2 / k, auc_inf = dose / (v * k); standard errors by the delta method
